evidence.conflict_check: The same user/request_id with different filters returns a conflict.
evidence.real_api_retry: Two POST requests with the same request_id returned the same paper 40 and question 877.

limitations: The replay cache is process-local and expires after ten minutes; restart-safe MySQL persistence is not implemented.
No scope hash is stored because the user explicitly decided that the question-bank schema must not contain hash fields.
